description.value:
Activate 3 (manipulate)

A small jar of thick, gritty paste in a dull, chalky grey, flecked with glittering mineral grains. It is smooth enough to spread and smells faintly of stone dust and metal.

This Insulating Paste is attuned to acid damage.

Slather Insulating Paste over a willing or unconscious creature's exposed skin. Once applied, it remains as a thin film on the creature's skin, granting the creature resistance 5 to acid damage.

Insulating Paste grants 5 instances of protection, regardless of tier. Each time this resistance reduces damage from an attack, the paste loses one instance of protection, wearing away a little more. Once it has no instances of protection remaining, the film wears away completely and the effect ends immediately, even mid-combat. The effect also ends if its duration runs out, whichever happens first.

Duration 10 minutes.
